changes.why: أَدْرَكَ is past tense (mirrors the second occurrence in token 0010, glossed 'اس نے پا لیا'); 'پا لے' is a present/subjunctive form inconsistent with the verb tense and with the parallel clause.

الرَّكْعَةَ means 'the rak'ah' (a full prayer unit), not 'رکوع' (the bowing position) — these are distinct Arabic words (ركعة vs ركوع) and the mistranslation changes the meaning; English gloss 'the raka'ah' was already correct.
